jobs.role: IT Intern – Gadget & Tech Support Operations
jobs.expYears: Student or recent graduate; prior technical support experience is advantageous
jobs.desc: Instawork is hiring an IT Intern for gadget and technical support operations in Koramangala, Bangalore. This is an on-site operational IT role supporting data collection teams and internal coordinators. The intern sets up and maintains Apple iPhones, SD cards, readers and transfer systems, troubleshoots hardware and software issues, handles video uploads, and coordinates gadget readiness. The operation runs 24/7 with multiple morning and night shifts.
jobs.elig: IT, Computer Science or Electronics student or recent graduate preferred. Practical knowledge of iPhones/iOS, Apple ID account management, storage and data-transfer devices, troubleshooting, and clear technical communication. Prior mobile-device or IT support experience is an advantage, not a confirmed mandatory requirement. Must be comfortable with shift-based operations.
resp: Set up, inventory, and maintain iPhones, SD cards and card readers used by project teams.
Create and manage Apple IDs and device configurations for operational needs.
Troubleshoot iPhone, SD-card and data-transfer issues.
Upload video files to designated rigs or systems and verify data integrity.
Format SD cards after completed uploads according to SOPs.
Check gadget functionality and readiness before deployment.
Coordinate with inventory and operations teams to resolve shortages.
Communicate device updates and support teams during live operations.
Maintain logs and trackers of gadget incidents and resolutions.
